text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s race is drawing near. I'm
sure we've done enough
running in preparation,
but I can't quite
shake off my anxieties...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I fret about whether our training has
been
enough to win, a certain racer
happens by...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a stern look on your face. Is

something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I can deeply relate to that state of
mind.
choice_data_list: I'm starting to get a little anxio...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, it would be best not to display
your
unease so freely, lest it make your
trainee anxious
as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, you two should have
confidence in yourselves. The number
and quality of your runs
are second to
none.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good results will surely follow, so be
calm in your heart and rest assured. Of
course, I suppose this is
much easier said
than done.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There must be more I can do to reassure
you...
Ah, I have just the idea. Tell me
how you are
preparing for your race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Focusing on speed while preserving
energy... I
see. Yes, I expected as much.
That's an orthodox
and logical approach.
choice_data_list: Focus on light speed work for the ...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The path you have chosen is
well-traveled, which,
I suppose, is
precisely why you feel so uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But worry not. Staying on that path will

undoubtedly lead to glory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe you two have the strength to
follow the
road you've chosen. There is
no need to doubt
yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's words ease my
anxieties a little,
and I feel confidence
welling up within me once
more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm, I see. So you're allaying those fears
of yours
by training intensely and
preparing for any and all
possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though it may not be the most orthodox

approach, I can see how it might be the
best one
for your current situation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Once you lose yourself to the thrill of
the run, all your fears, doubts, and
apprehensions will be left
behind in the
dust like forgotten sighs.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I believe you have made the right
choice. Go
forth and guide your racer
with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's words ease my
anxieties a little,
and I feel confidence
welling up within me once
more.
